positive_rule: control_validated on every symbol claimed AND at least TWO of {BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT} with >= 50 scored trades AND those symbols each at M1 >= 95.0 and M2 >= 95.0
positive_rule_declared_at: EDGE.md §36e, commit d18a3b8, before any number existed
readings_summary: BTC 97.0/97.5 POSITIVE (n=85, control VALID); ETH 47.7/48.5 ABSENT (n=76, control VALID); SOL 2.3/1.0 ABSENT (n=162, control VALID, M2 delta -0.1315 with a CI excluding zero)
why_absent_not_inconclusive: Three readings were taken. Every control passed all three pre-declared clauses at 0% incompletes and every symbol cleared the >= 50-trade gate (85/76/162). INCONCLUSIVE means no reading exists; here three do, and the conjunction they were measured against failed.
why_not_almost_positive: Best-of-three at a 95th percentile occurs about 14% of the time under a global null; the three readings disagree in SIGN, and the largest sample (SOLUSDT, 162 trades) disagrees hardest with a 95% CI on its M2 delta of [-0.1402, -0.1229], excluding zero on the wrong side.
btc_artefact_note: Retained UNEDITED and still reading EDGE_EVIDENCE_POSITIVE. It is evidence of a true single-symbol reading, not a cleared edge. Deleting it would be the worse of the two available dishonesties: a repository that removes its one inconvenient artefact is one whose remaining artefacts mean less.
intake_status: COMPLETED — CLOSED; next slot WAITING — EMPTY
forbidden_without_a_new_human_intake: registering BTCUSDT alone as a cleared edge, by any route
deleting, editing, weakening or inflating the BTCUSDT POSITIVE artefact
lowering FUND_ABS or changing the stop, take profit, horizon or cost model
dropping ETHUSDT or SOLUSDT from the universe post-hoc
re-scoring under a changed universe without a new pre-declaration
treating a single-symbol in-sample clear as a licence for a model, shadow trading or live
closer_note: NO. This slice closes a measured family. Closing one is how a research programme stays honest; it is not progress toward profit. What it adds is narrower and real: the repository can hold a true 97th-percentile reading and still say null, enforced in two independent places in code.
